|errata_history=This is the original printed text, and the current text: the PC-E1 errata of 13 April 2013 ([[Wookiee Guide (V) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata)]]) was rescinded two days later.
* '''Original''' (this page): Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009), slip 68<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=7 Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of December 7, 2009"), page 7, slip 68. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=7 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Stack a Wookiee from your Lost Pile on Grrrghrrrgh!. OR Deploy a Wookiee stacked on Grrrghrrrgh! to Kashyyyk (as if from hand). OR Once per game, draw X cards from top of Reserve Deck, where X = number of cards stacked on Grrrghrrrgh!.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-68-Wookiee_Guide.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-L-wookieeguide-pre.gif]]) print it; it is the current text.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Wookiee Guide (V) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata)]], rescinded): on 13 April 2013 the Players Committee rules forum posted, effective immediately, an errata adding “(as if just lost)”, so that a Wookiee stacked from Lost Pile is inactive, like the Wookiees Grrrghrrrgh! stacks itself: “Stack a Wookiee (as if just lost) from your Lost Pile on Grrrghrrrgh!. OR Deploy a Wookiee stacked on Grrrghrrrgh! to Kashyyyk (as if from hand). OR Once per game, draw X cards from top of Reserve deck, where X = number of cards stacked on Grrrghrrrgh!.”<ref name="pcforum-p802181">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574, now titled “Current Rulings Archive August 2012 - December 2015”), post by Lukes Bionic Hand, 13 April 2013, “effective immediately” ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574#p802181 forum post]; preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20150320030739/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/forums/viewtopic.php?f=871&t=36574#p802181 Internet Archive])</ref> The post writes “Reserve deck” (the card prints “Reserve Deck”); the text is given here as posted. On 15 April 2013 the errata was rescinded<ref name="pcforum-p802670">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574), post by Lukes Bionic Hand, 15 April 2013 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=20#p802670 forum post]): “The recent errata to Tarfful, Wookiee Insurgent/Kashyyyk Insurgent Leader and Wookiee Guide (v) have been rescinded.”</ref> (the post adds that the wording “made wookiees stacked by it vulnerable to Special Delivery (v)”), and the card went back to the original text; on 16 April 2013 a ruling made every card stacked on Grrrghrrrgh! supporting instead<ref name="pcforum-p802901">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574), post by Lukes Bionic Hand, 16 April 2013 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=20#p802901 forum post]): “All cards stacked on Grrrghrrrgh! are considered supporting, regardless of what state they were in before being stacked.”</ref>. No published card image shows this text; the image of [[Wookiee Guide (V) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata)]] is a CardMaker recreation. Rescinded errata are counted as versions (Bill, 10 November 2026).
